description: Update a Lead - Update lead/contact properties including custom fields. All field names use snake_case (e.g. first_name, company_name, lead_score). The `starred` boolean is a contact setting and is not added as a list column. Contact archiving is handled by archive_contact.

starred.description: Mark/unmark the lead as starred. This is a contact setting, not a data field/column.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: update_lead

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Update Lead
